item.title: Covidien, LP: Surgipro II S8698GX SURGIPRO II BL 5/0 18 P-13 S8698GX Recall
item.product: Surgipro II S8698GX SURGIPRO II BL 5/0 18 P-13 S8698GX
item.summary: Product may contain a perforation or tear in the sterile barrier packaging. This issue may result in biocontamination of the sterile sutures, which may lead to infection, loss of vision if in ophthalmic utilization, or prolonged surgery. Product details: Surgipro II S8698GX SURGIPRO II BL 5/0 18 P-13 S8698GX
